pool.text: An invasion occurred affecting the area of Busan.
The port of Busan and a waegwan were established.
The waegwan located in Busan was closed.
The shrine Songgongsa was built to honor those who died defending Korea.
Diplomatic relations with the new shogunate in Japan were established.
The shrine Songgongsa was dubbed Chungnyeolsa.
The waegwan was moved to Choryang.
Busan became the first place in Korea to have sweet potatoes.
Busan adopted a division system with the creation of six gu.
Busan separated from South Gyeongsang Province to become a Directly Governed City.
The provincial capital of Gyeongsangnam-do was moved from Busan to Changwon.
The establishment of the Busan Film Commission marked the city's emergence as a filming destination.
Busan officially replaced the earlier McCune-Reischauer romanization Pusan.
Busan hosted an APEC summit.
German artist Hendrik Beikirch painted Asia's tallest mural entitled Fisherman Portrait.
Busan was added to the UNESCO Creative Cities Network as a City of Film.
The city hosts the One Asia Festival, the largest K-pop festival in Korea.
Ananti Hilton Busan opened in the Gijang-eup district.
The port of Busan processed 21.81 million TEU of container cargo volume.
Busan hosted the China-United States Busan Summit.
